这篇写给两种玩家：一是路过洞口不知道该不该进的新手，二是已经攒了十几颗泡泡宝石、不知道该找谁换的收集党。洞窟系统没有剧情门槛，下了空岛就能开始，但建议先拿到滑翔伞再系统性地跑——很多洞口在悬崖半腰，没有滑翔伞会跑得很狼狈。

This guide is written for two kinds of players: first, beginners who pass a cave entrance and don't know whether to go in, and second, collectors who have already saved up a dozen or so Bubbul Gems and don't know who to trade them with. The cave system has no story gate — you can start once you leave the sky island — but it is best to get the Paraglider first before running caves systematically, as many cave entrances sit halfway up cliffs and are miserable to reach without a Paraglider.
先说清两个数，避免一开始就记混：全游戏有 147 座洞窟，但洞窟入口标记有 197 个——因为不少洞窟有多个入口。数洞窟按 147 算，数入口按 197 算，两者都对，说的不是一回事。另外井不算洞窟，井有自己的一套标记。

First, let's get two numbers straight so you don't mix them up from the start: the game has 147 caves in total, but there are 197 cave entrance markers — because quite a few caves have multiple entrances. Count caves as 147, count entrances as 197; both are correct, they just aren't talking about the same thing. Also, wells do not count as caves; wells have their own set of markers.

洞窟不是单纯的山洞，它是王国之泪里密度最高的“奖励容器”之一。进一座洞，通常能拿到下面几类东西：
A cave is not just a hole in a mountain; it is one of the densest 'reward containers' in Tears of the Kingdom. Entering a cave, you can usually get the following kinds of things:
宝箱与防具。不少套装部件直接藏在洞窟宝箱里，跑洞是拿齐套装最稳定的路子之一。
Treasure chests and armor. Quite a few armor set pieces are hidden directly in cave chests, making cave-running one of the most reliable ways to complete sets.
宝箱与防具
Treasure chests and armor

矿石与夜光石。洞壁常有矿石与夜光石矿脉，缺钱缺材料时顺路敲一圈不亏。
Ores and Luminous Stones. Cave walls often have ore and Luminous Stone veins, so mining a round on your way is never a loss when you are short of money or materials.

洞窟内部结构差异很大：有的笔直到底，有的上下分层带水域，有的要炸开石墙才有后半段。进洞前先在洞口抬头看一眼——发光青蛙经常贴在洞顶或高处岩壁上，低头赶路最容易错过它。

Cave interiors vary greatly: some run straight to the end, some have multiple levels with water areas, and some need stone walls blasted open to reveal the second half. Before entering, look up at the cave entrance — the glowing frog often clings to the cave ceiling or high rock walls, and rushing in with your head down is the easiest way to miss it.
对着地图一个个找洞口是最笨的办法。游戏里给了系统性的找洞工具：樱花树。海拉鲁各地都有樱花树，树下有一个小供奉盘，做法如下：

Searching for cave entrances one by one on the map is the dumbest method. The game gives you a systematic cave-finding tool: cherry blossom trees. There are cherry blossom trees all over Hyrule, each with a small offering dish beneath it. Here's how it works:
找到一棵樱花树，往树下的供奉盘里放任意一种果实——苹果就行，不必是特定果实，放进去的果实事后还可以取回来。
Find a cherry blossom tree and place any kind of fruit in the offering dish beneath it — an apple will do, it doesn't need to be a specific fruit, and you can take the fruit back afterwards.

山神萨托利现身，附近区域的洞窟位置会被一道道光柱标出来。光柱不是永久的，只持续一段游戏时间。
The Lord of the Mountain, Satori, appears, and the cave locations in the nearby region are marked by pillars of light. The pillars are not permanent; they only last for a period of in-game time.

Immediately open the map and mark each pillar's location one by one. After the pillars disappear, the marks remain, and you can then run caves by following the marks.

关键点只有两个：光柱只标附近区域的洞窟，不是全图，所以要按区域一棵树一棵树地供奉；供奉完别先做别的事，先把标记打完再走，否则光柱没了又要重供一次。萨托利山的那棵樱花树是最出名的一棵，刚学会这招时可以先去那里练一次手。

There are only two key points: the pillars only mark caves in the nearby region, not the whole map, so you must offer tree by tree, region by region; and after offering, don't do anything else first — finish marking before you leave, or once the pillars are gone you will have to offer again. The cherry blossom tree on Satori Mountain is the most famous one, and a good place to practice when you first learn this trick.

魔犹伊就是洞窟里那只发光的青蛙，身上顶着一颗泡泡状的光球。它不是 Boss，没有血条概念：打中一击就掉一颗泡泡宝石，用什么武器都行。但它会逃跑，处理不好就白跑一趟：

A Bubbulfrog is the glowing frog in a cave, with a bubble-shaped ball of light on top of it. It is not a Boss and has no health-bar concept: one hit drops one Bubbul Gem, with any weapon. But it will flee, and if you handle it badly the trip is wasted:

Spot it first, then act. After entering a cave, look around the ceiling and rock walls first and find the frog before approaching. Rushing straight at it will startle it, and it hops away pretty fast.

First choice: one ranged bow shot. Aim carefully and shoot — one arrow ends the fight and gives it no chance to flee. Melee weapons easily miss, and one miss and it starts fleeing.

Cave completion progress management relies on this check mark: run caves have a mark, unrun caves don't. Combined with the cherry blossom tree pillar marks, comparing the two sets of marks clearly shows how many caves remain unrun in a region.
泡泡宝石的用途只有一个：交给柯尔天换奖励。柯尔天是基尔顿的弟弟，一心想变成呀哈哈（Blupee），为此收集泡泡宝石。见他有两个前提：先接取迷你挑战“寻找柯尔天”；他只在夜里现身，而且位置经常变化，白天去是找不到人的，找不到时先找地方睡到晚上再去。

Bubbul Gems have only one use: give them to Koltin in exchange for rewards. Koltin is Kilton's younger brother, single-mindedly wanting to become a Blupee, and collects Bubbul Gems for that purpose. There are two prerequisites for meeting him: first take on the mini-challenge 'Finding Koltin'; and he only appears at night, and his location changes often — going in daytime you won't find him, so if you can't find him, first find somewhere to sleep until night and then go.

The Mystic Set (Headpiece, Robe, Trousers) has an effect called 'Rupee Padding': while wearing it, taking damage deducts Rupees instead of hearts. It sounds invincible, but in practice it comes with a discount:
卢比烧得很快。挨打一次扣的卢比不少，钱包不厚时穿它打硬仗，几下就把钱打光了；钱打光后效果也就没了。
Rupees burn fast. Each hit deducts a fair amount of Rupees, so wearing it for a hard fight with a thin wallet will drain your money in a few hits; once the money is gone, the effect is gone too.

Its real use is 'room for error,' not 'tank.' Suitable scenarios are: challenging fights where you usually make mistakes, or taking it to fight an unfamiliar Boss — buying one mistake with Rupees, rather than standing and trading blows while wearing it.

作者视角的判断：神秘套装值得换，但别把它当毕业套。它的价值在于“多一次容错”，而卢比在本作里越到后期越不值钱——后期卢比多到没处花时，这套装才真正进入完全体。

The author's judgment: the Mystic Set is worth trading for, but don't treat it as an endgame set. Its value lies in 'one more chance for error,' and Rupees become less and less valuable the later you get in this game — only when you have more Rupees than you can spend late in the game does this set truly reach its full form.
46 颗换完常规奖励后，柯尔天还会继续收宝石，但不再给新装备——直到你把全游戏的 147 颗全部交给他。集齐 147 颗后，他会实现变成呀哈哈的愿望，并送你最后的礼物：柯尔天滑翔伞布料，可以用来定制滑翔伞外观。

After the 46 gems for the regular rewards, Koltin will keep accepting gems, but no longer gives new gear — until you hand him all 147 gems in the game. Once you have collected all 147, he will fulfill his wish to become a Blupee and give you his final gift: Koltin's Paraglider Fabric, which can be used to customize your Paraglider's appearance.

The long tail of these 101 gems is purely collectors' homework: no combat benefit, only the fabric and a story conclusion. Players aiming for full completion will find it much easier to advance region by region using the cherry blossom tree method plus the map check-mark method than to run hard against a checklist.

⚠️ 坑一：供奉完樱花树不打标记。光柱只持续一段时间，跑去做别的事再回来，光柱没了，等于白供一次。供奉完第一件事永远是开地图打标记。

⚠️ Pitfall 1: Offering at a cherry blossom tree without marking. The pillars only last a while; if you go off to do something else and come back, the pillars are gone, and the offering was wasted. The first thing after offering is always to open the map and mark.

⚠️ Pitfall 2: Chasing a Bubbulfrog and missing with melee. One miss and it flees, burrowing into its hole and disappearing. Find the frog first after entering, then act — settle it with one bow shot, don't chase it with melee.

洞窟的优先级分三档：第一档是顺路跑——推主线、开神庙路过洞口就进去，宝箱、矿石、青蛙一趟全拿；第二档是 46 颗目标——有意识地攒到 46 颗，把神秘套装与面具换齐，这是洞窟系统真正的战斗力收益；第三档是 147 颗全收集——只留给想拿滑翔伞布料与完整剧情的玩家，不必强求。

Cave priorities come in three tiers: tier one is running caves on the way — when pushing the main quest or opening Shrines, go in whenever you pass a cave entrance, getting chests, ores, and the frog in one trip; tier two is the 46-gem goal — deliberately save up to 46 gems and trade for the full Mystic Set and masks, which is the cave system's real combat benefit; tier three is the 147-gem full collection — only for players who want the Paraglider Fabric and the complete story, and not something to force.
一句话总结：洞窟系统奖励的是“顺路的耐心”，不是“清单式的苦力”。樱花树找洞、弓箭打蛙、夜里找柯尔天，三步形成闭环，跑上十几座洞，这套流程就比任何清单都顺手。

In one sentence: the cave system rewards 'patience along the way,' not 'checklist drudgery.' Finding caves with cherry blossom trees, hitting frogs with a bow, and finding Koltin at night — these three steps form a loop, and after running a dozen or so caves, this routine feels smoother than any checklist.
